'''High Port Immigration''' was an organization that operated from the [[High Port Space Center]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] that handled the arrival of individuals to the world. They were responsible for informing [[Larsh Hill]] of the arrival of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] from [[Deep Space Demolition and Removal]].
